"""Main: commit closed official full32K and new integration admission evidence."""
import fcntl
import hashlib
import importlib.util
import json
from pathlib import Path
import time

B = Path('/home/yayoi/.local/state/strata-sycl/post-reboot-tuning-20261007')
D = Path('/home/yayoi/ghq/github.com/yqYo1/Strata/.worktree/docs-sycl-storage-retention-20261009')
W = D.parent / 'sync-xe-v0143-nonfinite-20261012'
F = D / 'bench/results/2026-10-12-latest-updates-pristine-builds-host-regression'
L = Path('/home/yayoi/ghq/github.com/MistVVK/XeStrata/.worktree/fix-xestrata-e32-host-handoff-20261011/.lint')
O = B / 'xe-llvm-v711-source-v5/direct_owner.py'
assert hashlib.sha256(O.read_bytes()).hexdigest() == 'a29d8257eecc77c4ad9ae6671d092b56f4c09a35c4247c125fed3a8c8bc1f95f'
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('official_long_boundary_owner', O)
m = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(m)
ENV = dict(PATH=str(L/'bin')+':/usr/bin:/bin', HOME='/home/yayoi', LANG='C.UTF-8', LC_ALL='C.UTF-8')

def identity(p):
    return dict(path=str(p), sha256=m.sha(p), bytes=p.stat().st_size)

def compact(value):
    if isinstance(value, dict):
        result = {}
        for key, item in value.items():
            if 'token' in key and isinstance(item,str) and len(item)==64 and all(c in '0123456789abcdef' for c in item):
                result[key] = {'sha256':item}
            elif key == 'token_logprob_sha256':
                result['token_logprob_identity'] = {'sha256':item}
            elif key in ('evidence','command_evidence') and isinstance(item,dict) and all(isinstance(fields,dict) and all(isinstance(text,str) for text in fields.values()) for fields in item.values()):
                result[key] = {label:{channel:dict(bytes=len(text.encode()), sha256=hashlib.sha256(text.encode()).hexdigest(),
                    content=text if len(text.encode()) <= 16384 else text[:8192]+'\n[compact middle omitted]\n'+text[-4096:])
                    for channel,text in fields.items()} for label,fields in item.items()}
            else:
                result[key] = compact(item)
        return result
    if isinstance(value, list):
        return [compact(v) for v in value]
    if isinstance(value, str) and len(value.encode()) > 32768:
        return dict(bytes=len(value.encode()), sha256=hashlib.sha256(value.encode()).hexdigest(),
                    head=value[:8192], tail=value[-4096:], scope='Compact derivative; exact original remains pinned for current admission consumer')
    return value


NAMES = ['latest-update-main-official-long-boundary-root-v4',
    'latest-update-main-integrated-provider-health-xe-debug-off-root-v1',
    'latest-update-main-integrated-provider-health-xe-debug-on-root-v1',
    'latest-update-main-integrated-provider-health-xe-timed1-off-root-v1',
    'latest-update-integrated-neutral-model-root-v5/xe-debug-off',
    'latest-update-integrated-neutral-model-root-v5/xe-debug-on',
    'latest-update-main-controller-cpu-root-v12','latest-update-main-controller-cpu-root-v13',
    'latest-update-main-integrated-admission-root-v4',
    'latest-update-main-integrated-v6-provider-health-xe-startup-root-v1',
    'latest-update-integrated-neutral-model-root-v6/xe-startup']

with (B/'owned-v0141-measurement.lock').open('a') as lock:
    fcntl.flock(lock,fcntl.LOCK_EX|fcntl.LOCK_NB)
    out=B/'latest-update-main-integrated-control-boundary-root-v1'
    assert not out.exists()
    out.mkdir()
    r=dict(active=True,passed=False,complete=False,commands=[],controller=identity(Path(__file__)),gpu_executed=False,artifacts=[])
    def save(): (out/'record.json').write_text(json.dumps(r,indent=2)+'\n')
    owner=m.Owner(out/'commands',save);r['commands']=owner.commands;begin=time.monotonic()
    staged=out/'staged';staged.mkdir();prepared=[]
    def write(relative,value):
        p=staged/relative;p.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
        raw=json.dumps(value,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n'
        assert len(raw.encode())<1<<20,(relative,len(raw.encode()))
        p.write_text(raw);prepared.append((p,F/relative))
    def run(label,argv,cwd=D):
        left=600-(time.monotonic()-begin);assert left>0
        c,so,se=owner.run(label,argv,ENV,cwd,wall=min(120,left),cpu=480,rss_cap=8<<30,text_cap=64<<20,file_cap=64<<20,total_cap=96<<20)
        r.setdefault('evidence',{})[label]=dict(stdout=so.read_text(),stderr=se.read_text());save()
        assert m.closed(c) and c['session_anchored'] and c['exit_code']==0,label
        return so.read_text().strip()
    try:
        assert not run('status-before',['/usr/bin/git','status','--porcelain','--untracked-files=all'])
        assert run('branch',['/usr/bin/git','branch','--show-current'])=='docs/sycl-storage-retention-2026-10-09'
        assert run('origin',['/usr/bin/git','remote','get-url','origin'])=='git@github.com:yqYo1/Strata.git'
        assert all(x.startswith('file:/home/yayoi/.config/git/config') for x in run('identity',['/usr/bin/git','config','--show-origin','--get-regexp',r'^user\.(name|email)$']).splitlines())
        records={}
        for name in NAMES:
            p=B/name/'record.json';v=json.loads(p.read_text());assert not v['active']
            assert all(c['direct_child_reaped'] and c['session_empty'] and c['session_anchored'] and c['ownership_status']=='observed' and not c['cleanup'] and not c['survivors'] for c in v.get('commands',[])+v.get('guard_commands',[]))
            records[name]=v
            write('receipts/'+name.replace('/','--')+'.json',dict(original=identity(p),derivative=True,original_status_preserved=True,original_passed=v['passed'],receipt=compact(v)))
        research=[]
        for n in range(236,241):
            found=list((B/'research-20261009').glob('*round'+str(n)+'-v1.txt'));assert len(found)==1;research+=found
        entries=[]
        for p in research:
            relative='research/'+p.name;target=staged/relative;target.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True);target.write_text(p.read_text().rstrip('\n')+'\n');prepared.append((target,F/relative))
            entries.append(dict(original=identity(p),archive=str((F/relative).relative_to(D)),archive_identity=identity(target),normalization='Only repeated EOF newlines normalized; original unchanged',model='gpt-6-luna',main_full_report_review=True,status='completed',measured=False))
        prior=F/'report-registry-v156.json';previous=json.loads(prior.read_text());assert previous['research_completed']==736
        write('report-registry-v157.json',dict(research_completed=736+len(entries),prior_registry_path=str(prior.relative_to(D)),prior_registry_sha256=m.sha(prior),new_reports=entries,main_sole_execution_owner=True))
        sources=[B/name for name in ['latest-update-main-integrated-phase-v1.py','latest-update-main-integrated-phase-v2.py','latest-update-main-controller-cpu-v12.py','latest-update-main-controller-cpu-v13.py','latest-update-main-integrated-admission-v3.py','latest-update-main-integrated-admission-v4.py','latest-update-main-integrated-provider-health-v2.py','latest-update-main-official-long-boundary-v2.py','latest-update-main-official-long-boundary-v3.py',Path(__file__).name]]
        sources += [p for p in sorted((B/'latest-update-integrated-neutral-controller-source-v6').iterdir()) if p.is_file() and p.suffix in ('.py','.json','.txt','.patch')]
        sources += [B/'latest-update-main-integrated-clean-prelaunch-failure-v1.json',B/'latest-update-main-integrated-startup-review-v1.json',B/'latest-update-main-integrated-startup-review-v2.json']
        source_index=[]
        for index,p in enumerate(sources):
            relative='controller-sources-v157/'+str(index).zfill(3)+'-'+p.parent.name+'-'+p.name+'.json'
            write(relative,dict(identity=identity(p),content=p.read_text()));source_index.append(dict(original=identity(p),archive=relative))
        write('controller-source-v157.json',dict(files=source_index))
        on=records['latest-update-integrated-neutral-model-root-v5/xe-debug-on'];off=records['latest-update-integrated-neutral-model-root-v5/xe-debug-off']
        assert on['passed'] and off['passed'] and on['pair_comparison']['token_logprob_equal']
        write('integrated32k-debug-results-v157.json',dict(source_revision='0691bcdf5af63a85b3b25650f367d3276db64035',
            samples=[dict(phase=v['phase'],argv=v['argv'],environment=v['environment'],effective_info=v['effective_info'],validation=compact(v['validation']),host_wall=v['host_wall_samples'],normal_close=v['model_close'],fault_gate=v['kernel_gate_passed'],performance_eligible=False) for v in (off,on)],
            pair_comparison=compact(on['pair_comparison']),actual_full32k_integration_passed=True,model_fault_observed=False,
            corrections={'clean_provider':'Native clean probe omits only validation library. Original strict debug8 contract refused before model root/import. Fresh v6 source/admission has exact observed diagnostic8 and clean7 profiles; fresh entire campaign, original statuses unchanged.',
                'CPU12':'Main helper retained old source basename, so its pending fixture refused existing old campaign. Failed CPU12 preserved; corrected new Main13 tested new source6 successfully.',
                'guard_phase':'R240 shows production detector only on verifier windows. In actual batched8192 prefill no production detector runs during prefill; one-pair prefill timing difference is not a guard effect.',
                'CPU_limit':'RLIMIT_CPU is cumulative across each child process threads, not aggregate across its descendant session. Finite wall/session RSS remains governing limit.',
                'upstream_batched':'R238 original large batch still reaches unsupported host/device marker polling; capability alone does not prove volatile access has happens-before. Unpatched window8 remains qualified; larger route excluded until synchronization resolved.'},
            primary_reference='https://registry.khronos.org/SYCL/specs/sycl-2020/html/sycl-2020.html#sec:usm',
            official_parameter_optimization_complete=False,clean_three_pairs_pending=True,whole37462_pending=True,full262144_runtime_qualified=False,
            next=['Finish new v6 fresh campaign, retain every clean32K phase sample and whole37462 comparison','Actual normal-limit property probe, then source-bound official cache512 and auto tuning','No default guard removal or precision adoption from LP5 or one debug pair']))
        leak=out/'secret-scan.json';run('private-secret-scan',[str(L/'bin/gitleaks'),'dir',str(staged),'--no-banner','--redact','--report-format','json','--report-path',str(leak)]);assert json.loads(leak.read_text())==[]
        run('report-lints',['/bin/bash',str(W/'tools/lint/run.sh'),*[str(p) for p,_ in prepared if p.suffix=='.json']],cwd=W)
        for p,target in prepared:
            assert not target.exists();target.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True);target.write_bytes(p.read_bytes());r['artifacts'].append(identity(target))
        run('whole-secret-scan',[str(L/'bin/gitleaks'),'dir',str(F),'--no-banner','--redact'])
        run('stage',['/usr/bin/git','add','--',*[str(target.relative_to(D)) for _,target in prepared]])
        run('check',['/usr/bin/git','diff','--cached','--check'])
        run('commit',['/usr/bin/git','commit','-m','docs(sycl): record integrated32K parity and clean-provider admission'])
        r['revision']=run('head',['/usr/bin/git','rev-parse','HEAD']);run('push',['/usr/bin/git','push','origin','HEAD'])
        assert not run('status-after',['/usr/bin/git','status','--porcelain'])
        r['complete']=True
    except BaseException as error:
        import traceback
        r['error']=repr(error);r['traceback']=traceback.format_exc()
    finally:
        r.update(active=owner.active is not None,finished_utc=m.utc());r['passed']=bool(r['complete'] and not r['active'] and not r.get('error'));save()
    print(json.dumps({k:r.get(k) for k in ('passed','error','revision')}))
    raise SystemExit(0 if r['passed'] else 1)
